subject: Re: NovaPay - Pricing & Token Volume Follow-up
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@novapay.com>, Alan Choi <alan.choi@novapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: NovaPay - Pricing & Token Volume Follow-up

Hi Emma / Alan,

Great to meet you on the call earlier 

— thanks for walking through NovaPay's product flow and the latency/throughput expectations. Quick recap and a few asks so we can finalize an invoice estimate:

Recap from our call:
- Primary use: realtime fraud-scoring + contextual reminders in payment flows.
- Expected production traffic: you mentioned a pilot target ~150M tokens/month, then ramp toward ~500M tokens/month over Q3.
- Target SLAs: 99.9% regional availability, p50 < 150ms.

Asks to finalize pricing/invoice estimate:
1) Can you confirm the expected monthly token volumes for the first 3 months (pilot, ramp month, steady-state)? If you have a CSV or sample usage profile that would help.
2) What internal budget range are you targeting for inference (if you have a $/1M tokens target range, please share)?
3) Who is the procurement/finance approver for formal invoices?

I've attached a first-pass pricing spreadsheet (nova_tokens_pricing_v1.xlsx) that shows unit economics across a few model variants and discount tiers; it's intentionally conservative. Once you confirm volumes and target $/1M we can produce a formal invoice estimate and line-item cost breakdown.

Next steps: if you can reply with the volumes and an approximate target $/1M tokens, I'll loop in Marissa (finance) and Dev (engineering) to produce the invoice and cost model.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: nova_tokens_pricing_v1.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@novapay.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Alan Choi <alan.choi@novapay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaPay - Pricing & Token Volume Follow-up

Thanks Sean 

— quick answers below and attaching our usage profile.

Monthly volumes (estimate):
- Pilot month (month 1): 150,000,000 tokens
- Ramp (month 2): 320,000,000 tokens
- Steady-state (month 3+): ~500,000,000 tokens/month (with 10-20% weekly variance)

Budget target: we are aiming for $150-$200 per 1M tokens for the initial procurement. Final signoff sits with Alan (cc'd).

Files: I've attached our sample usage CSV (novapay_usage_profile.csv) so you can model time-of-day and burst patterns.

Procurement timeline: We'd like a formal invoice + SOW by Friday 5/28 to keep our June procurement window.

Thanks 

Emma
Emma Jones
Head of Product, NovaPay
emma.jones@novapay.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

Attachments: novapay_usage_profile.csv (CSV)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@novapay.com>, Alan Choi <alan.choi@novapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaPay - Pricing & Token Volume Follow-up

Emma 

— perfect, thanks for the fast follow-up and the CSV. Looping in Marissa and Dev to lock down unit economics and a formal invoice.

Quick clarifying Qs for modeling:
- Are the token counts in the CSV already deduped per request (i.e., combined prompt + expected response tokens) or should we assume the CSV reflects prompt tokens only?
- Any planned model variants? We modeled a standard low-latency open model and a smaller quantized variant in the spreadsheet. If you want strict p50 latency <150ms we should assume the lower-latency (higher-cost) variant for baseline estimates.

I'm attaching an initial invoice estimate (novapay_invoice_estimate_v1.xlsx) and a compact cost breakdown PDF (redwood_cost_breakdown.pdf) 

Marissa, can you review discounts/tiers and propose a committed tier for HSP-7821?

Next: Marissa to propose a 3-tier pricing plan (pilot, ramp, committed) + suggested discount % for a 12-month commit. We'll send a final invoice + SOW once we align.

Thanks,
Sean

Attachments: novapay_invoice_estimate_v1.xlsx (XLSX), redwood_cost_breakdown.pdf (PDF)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: NovaPay pricing sketch (HSP-7821)

Internal note 

— quick pricing sketch for HSP-7821 based on Emma's volumes. Not for external distribution yet.

Assumptions
- Treat CSV as total tokens (prompt + response). If Dev says otherwise we'll adjust.
- Use two model bands: Low-latency (baseline cost = $220 / 1M tokens) and Quantized (baseline cost = $140 / 1M tokens).

Proposed public-facing tiers
- Pilot (0-200M/mo): list $220/1M, applied discount 10% for 3mo pilot -> effective $198/1M
- Ramp (200-400M/mo): list $200/1M, discount 15% for 6mo ramp -> effective $170/1M
- Committed (400M+): list $180/1M, 20% for 12mo -> effective $144/1M

Line-item notes for invoice_estimate_v1.xlsx
- Per-token compute consumed (modeled by seq len distribution from CSV)
- Reserved throughput buffer (5% capacity premium)
- Optional: inference cache credits line removed if they do not want caching

Dev: confirm whether the CSV token counts include both prompt and response and validate the latency model assumptions. If they want the strict p50 <150ms tier, we should mark Low-latency as recommended.

Marissa
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@novapay.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Alan Choi <alan.choi@novapay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaPay - Pricing & Token Volume Follow-up

Thanks 

— this looks sensible. Confirming:
- We accept the proposed Pilot and Ramp pricing bands as written.
- For the committed volume target let's start with a 6-month ramp and then revisit a 12-month commit after the pilot.
- Alan is the procurement approver; he'll need the final invoice + SOW for review.

Alan, please confirm you saw the estimate and let us know if procurement can sign by 5/28.

Sean / Marissa: please send the formal invoice (novapay_invoice_estimate_v1.xlsx updated per Marissa's notes) and a short SOW doc. We can route DocuSign once procurement approves.
